questions.question: What does "Summary by Copilot" do at the top of an email thread in Outlook?
options: Generates a summary that highlights the key points and identifies actions where possible
Deletes the original messages after summarizing
Emails the summary to everyone in the thread
Only summarizes threads you have already replied to
questions.explanation: Copilot summarizes the thread, highlighting key points and pointing out possible action items. It does not delete messages or send the summary to participants.

questions.question: What does "Coaching by Copilot" in Outlook do?
options: Reviews a draft you wrote and suggests improvements to tone, clarity, and structure
Writes a brand-new draft instead of giving feedback on yours
Only checks spelling and grammar
Sends the email on your behalf
questions.explanation: Coaching analyzes your own draft and suggests improvements to tone, clarity, and structure, which you can apply one at a time or all at once.

questions.question: Teams intelligent recap requires transcription to be turned on in order to provide its AI meeting notes and AI-recommended tasks.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Intelligent recap depends on transcription. If recording is off you can still get a recap, but it comes without the recording, speakers, topics, and chapters.

questions.question: After a Teams meeting, where do you find AI meeting notes and AI-recommended tasks?
options: In the Recap tab in the Teams calendar and chat
Only during the live meeting; nothing is available afterward
As a plain video recording with no notes or tasks
They are emailed to you as a PDF only
questions.explanation: Intelligent recap provides AI notes, recommended tasks, speaker markers, and chapters through the Recap tab in the Teams calendar and chat after the meeting.

questions.question: Select all that a Copilot post-meeting summary in Teams can capture.
options: Who contributed to each topic
Where the team aligned or disagreed
Action items that were proposed
A full summary even when no transcript exists
questions.explanation: Using the transcript and chat, Copilot captures who contributed, where people agreed or disagreed, and proposed action items. It needs a transcript to generate the summary.

questions.question: Select all that apply about drafting an email with Copilot in Outlook ("Help me write").
options: If the draft is not right, you can adjust its tone or length
You can enter a new prompt and generate again before keeping it
The draft is sent automatically as soon as it is generated
Once generated, a draft can never be regenerated
questions.explanation: You can adjust tone and length or re-prompt and regenerate before keeping a draft. Nothing is sent automatically, and drafts can be regenerated.
